race.comment: BATISTA (7) disappointed on the quick turnaround two back but was a little better last time on the soft deck when beaten 4.1L. Back in trip now looks to suit, with the aid of an inside barrier. Tsang takes off 2kg and he can bounce back to his best form. EIGHTYSEVEN LAD (1) got the job done in a photo two back before a 0.6L defeat last time out at Bunbury when an $11 chance. Faithfull reunites today and with his early speed, he makes plenty of appeal. LANTA (3) finished out of the money two starts back then was beaten 0.9 lengths when fifth over 1400m at this track two weeks ago. Has his share of talent. Hard to beat in this suitable race. BUON AMICI (10) was in the money two starts back at this track but was unable to repeat the effort last time when 13th at this track over 1400m. Has his share of ability and can do a lot better. MAD SPITFIRE (2) got the job done last time out and can repeat the dose.
